users.title: Users
users.description:
This feature allows the system to have a list of Users and Roles.
Each role could have different permissions for different features
THIS FEATURE IS REQUIRED TO USE THE SYSTEM

members.title: Members
members.description:
The members of your {type}.
You can save all the necessary information for each member.

events_calendar.title: Events
events_calendar.description:
The events of your {type}.
You would visualize this in a calendar view.
Public events are available so everyone could see them, regardless if they have an User in the system or not.

events_attendance.title: Events Attendance
events_attendance.description: This will allow to record the attendance of each member to an event.

ministries.title: Ministries
ministries.description: This will allow you to assign members to ministries

ministries_calendar.title: Ministries Calendar
ministries_calendar.description: This will allow you to program a calendar for each ministry so each member could see their service days.
